dirfm.note: RIT. Read-only dependency; never modified here. pip install -e external/dirsig-file-maker

agent-docs.note: Rendered.ai agent-context repo. Design-pattern reference only; nothing imports from it.

dirsig.note: Licensed binary install (about 4 GB); linked, never copied or committed.

satsim-de421.note: JPL planetary ephemeris DE421, read by SatSim through skyfield (SATSIM_SKYFIELD_LOAD_DIR). Copied on 2026-10-11 from the local skyfield download (outputs/_orbit_data/de421.bsp); a fixed published file, so a fetch from the URL verifies.

satsim-iers-finals2000A.note: IERS Earth orientation (finals2000A, IAU 2000), a frozen snapshot of the auto-updating table, taken 2026-10-11 (astropy's download on the SatSim probe's first run; measured values to 2026-10-08, predictions after). Copied from ~/.astropy/cache. The URL serves the current table, which differs: a fetch is verified against this digest and refused when it does not match, so the snapshot itself must be kept (it cannot be re-fetched); a copy is committed at the `tracked` path, from which bootstrap.py assets restores it offline.
